title: Diamond Bank
description: A bank plugin that allows players to deposit and withdraw diamonds from their own bank accounts.
body:
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-NA?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=000000&color=00AF5C)](https://modrinth.com/project/diamond-bank) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-NA?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=000000&color=5865F2)](https://discord.gg/DfWRnvmSkb) [![Github](https://img.shields.io/badge/Github-NA?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=%23ffffff&color=%23000000)](https://github.com/doccyt/Diamond-Bank) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-NA?style=for-the-badge&color=%23ffa200)](https://doccdev.xyz)

**Diamond Bank** is a Lightweight and fast bank plugin that allows players do deposit, withdraw, and check balances of their own bank account.

Diamond Bank uses a configurable MySQL database connection. The max limit for withdrawing and depositing diamonds is 64 at one time. Diamond Bank also uses a config file that allows you to change the material from diamonds to emeralds, coal, oak logs, or any other vanilla block/material.

Diamond Bank is NOT compatible with custom NBT items or blocks, and is NOT compatible with economy.

**_COMMANDS_**

/bank deposit <amount>

/bank withdraw <amount>

/bank balance
